typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		NY_PA_STAGING_PyID as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE as date,
		PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		PROVIDER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MARKET as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER as date,
		TOTAL_CALLS_MADE as integer,
		PROVIDER_CALL_1_DATE as date,
		PROVIDER_CALL_1_RESULT as string,
		PROVIDER_CALL_2_DATE as date,
		PROVIDER_CALL_2_RESULT as string,
		PROVIDER_CALL_3_DATE as date,
		PROVIDER_CALL_3_RESULT as string,
		PROVIDER_CALL_4_DATE as date,
		PROVIDER_CALL_4_RESULT as string,
		PROVIDER_CALL_5_DATE as date,
		PROVIDER_CALL_5_RESULT as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as date,
		SCRUB_RESULT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: ' USE PDS_2008;  DECLARE @P_STARTDATE DATETIME ,@P_ENDDATE DATETIME ,@STARTDATE DATETIME ,@ENDDATE DATETIME  SET @P_STARTDATE = ? SET @P_ENDDATE = ?  IF @P_ENDDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @ENDDATE = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) ELSE 	SET @ENDDATE = @P_ENDDATE  IF @P_STARTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @STARTDATE = DATEADD(DAY, CASE  				WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @ENDDATE) = 2 					THEN - 3 				ELSE - 1 				END, @ENDDATE) ELSE 	SET @STARTDATE = @P_STARTDATE;    DECLARE @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY TABLE ( NY_PA_STAGING_PyID VARCHAR(20), 									NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE  Date, 									PROVIDER_NPI  VARCHAR(10), 									PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME VARCHAR(35), 									PROVIDER_LAST_NAME VARCHAR(35), 									MARKET VARCHAR(30), 									NY_PA_IID BIGINT)  INSERT INTO @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY  SELECT DISTINCT NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 	,CAST(NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE AS DATE) AS CLOSE_DATE 	,NPS.PROVIDER_NPI PROVIDER_NPI 	,NPS.PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME 	,NPS.PROVIDER_LAST_NAME 	,M.MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD AS MARKET 	,NPS.NY_PA_IID FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 	AND CL.CALLLIST_CD IN (\'381\', \'382\', \'334\') 	AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE BETWEEN @STARTDATE 		AND @ENDDATE INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 	/*AND ( 		CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID NOT IN (93,2, 45) 		OR CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID = 0 		)*/ INNER JOIN PDS_NY_PA_PROVIDER_HISTORY NPH ON NPH.NY_PA_PROVIDER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 		AND NPH.NY_PA_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID INNER JOIN PDS_2008.DBO.PDS_NY_PA_STAGING NPS ON  NPH.NY_PA_PROVIDER_pyID = NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_pyID AND NPH.NY_PA_IID=NPS.NY_PA_IID INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON   NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER WHERE  CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 0    	   DECLARE @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS TABLE ( NY_PA_STAGING_PyID VARCHAR(20), 									NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE  Date, 									PROVIDER_NPI  VARCHAR(10), 									PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME VARCHAR(35), 									PROVIDER_LAST_NAME VARCHAR(35), 									MARKET VARCHAR(30), 									CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(10), 									PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER DATE, 									PROVIDER_CALL_DATE DATE, 									PROVIDER_SCRUB_RULE_CD VARCHAR(50), 									PROVIDER_CALL_RESULT VARCHAR(50), 									HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST VARCHAR(50) , 									CALL_SEQ BIGINT, 									TOTAL_CALLS_MADE INT, 									SCRUB_FLG CHAR(1))  INSERT INTO @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS 	SELECT SCRB.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID	 	,SCRB.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE  CLOSE_DATE 	,SCRB.PROVIDER_NPI PROVIDER_NPI 	,SCRB.PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME 	,SCRB.PROVIDER_LAST_NAME 	,SCRB.MARKET 	,CAST(CL.CALLLIST_CD AS VARCHAR(4)) AS CALLLIST_CD 	,[CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT] AS PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER 	,CONVERT(DATE, CASE  			WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) > 20 				THEN DATEADD(DAY, 1, CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) 			ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE 			END) AS SCRUB_DATE 	,COALESCE(DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERDISPCODECD,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD, IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_CD)  AS SCRUB_RULE_CD 	,COALESCE(DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC, IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_DESC) AS SCRUB_RULE_DESC 	,ACL.CALLLIST_NAME AS HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST 	,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY SCRB.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,SCRB.NY_PA_IID ORDER BY CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) AS CALL_SEQ 	,COUNT(1) OVER(PARTITION BY SCRB.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,SCRB.NY_PA_IID)-1 AS TOTAL_CALLS_MADE 	,CASE WHEN DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN \'Y\' ELSE \'N\' END AS SCRUB_FLG  FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 	AND CL.CALLLIST_CD IN (\'381\', \'382\', \'334\') INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID INNER JOIN PDS_NY_PA_PROVIDER_HISTORY NPH ON NPH.NY_PA_PROVIDER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 		AND NPH.NY_PA_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID INNER JOIN @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY SCRB ON SCRB.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID = NPH.NY_PA_PROVIDER_pyID AND SCRB.NY_PA_IID=NPH.NY_PA_IID  LEFT JOIN  [PDS_2008].[dbo].[PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS] CS 	ON CM.[CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID] = [CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID] 	 AND CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID 	 AND CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITYTYPE_IID = 3 LEFT JOIN PDS_CALL C ON C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID LEFT JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON C.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTGROUPRULE IGR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID = IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID  LEFT JOIN ( 	SELECT CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 		,CL.CALLLIST_CD 		,CL.CallLIST_NAME 		,CLD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE 	FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CLD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CLD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CLM ON CLM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CLD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 		AND CL.CALLLISTGROUP_IID = 1 		AND CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 1 	) ACL ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = ACL.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 	AND CAST(ACL.CALLLISTDATE_DATE AS DATE) = CAST(CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE AS DATE) 	AND CL.CALLLIST_CD <> ACL.CALLLIST_CD 	AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID IS NOT NULL WHERE SCRB.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE < CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE 	AND COALESCE(DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERDISPCODECD,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD, IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_CD) IS NOT NULL   DECLARE @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS_DATE TABLE (	NY_PA_STAGING_PyID VARCHAR(20), 												NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE  Date, 												PROVIDER_NPI  VARCHAR(10), 												PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME VARCHAR(35), 												PROVIDER_LAST_NAME VARCHAR(35), 												MARKET VARCHAR(30), 												CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(5), 												PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER DATE, 												HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST VARCHAR(50) , 												TOTAL_CALLS_MADE INT, 												PROVIDER_CALL_1_DATE DATE, 												PROVIDER_CALL_2_DATE DATE, 												PROVIDER_CALL_3_DATE DATE, 												PROVIDER_CALL_4_DATE DATE, 												PROVIDER_CALL_5_DATE DATE, 												SCRUB_DATE DATE)  Insert into @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS_DATE SELECT  DISTINCT DT.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 	,	DT.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE 	,	DT.PROVIDER_NPI 	,	DT.PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME 	,	DT.PROVIDER_LAST_NAME 	,	DT.MARKET 	,	DT.CALLLIST_CD 	,	DT.PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER 	, 	DT.HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST 	,	DT.TOTAL_CALLS_MADE 	,	[1] PROVIDER_CALL_1_DATE 	,	[2] PROVIDER_CALL_2_DATE 	,	[3] PROVIDER_CALL_3_DATE 	,	[4] PROVIDER_CALL_4_DATE 	,	[5] PROVIDER_CALL_5_DATE 	,	SQ.MX_SD FROM (	 	SELECT NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 		,NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE 		,PROVIDER_NPI 		,PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME 		,PROVIDER_LAST_NAME,	MARKET 		,CALLLIST_CD 		,PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER 		,PROVIDER_CALL_DATE 		,HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST 		,TOTAL_CALLS_MADE 										,CALL_SEQ 			FROM @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS  	WHERE SCRUB_FLG=\'N\' 		AND CASE  		WHEN SCRUB_FLG=\'Y\'  THEN 0  		ELSE 1  	END	<=5 	)A PIVOT( MAX(PROVIDER_CALL_DATE)  FOR CALL_SEQ IN ([1], [2], [3], [4],[5]) 		) AS DT  INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT NY_PA_STAGING_PyID, MAX(PROVIDER_CALL_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY NY_PA_STAGING_PyID)  AS MX_SD FROM @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS ) SQ 	ON DT.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID = SQ.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID  UNION  SELECT  DISTINCT DT.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 	,	DT.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE 	,	DT.PROVIDER_NPI 	,	DT.PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME 	,	DT.PROVIDER_LAST_NAME 	,	DT.MARKET 	,	DT.CALLLIST_CD 	,	DT.PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER 	, 	DT.HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST 	,	DT.TOTAL_CALLS_MADE 	,	[2] PROVIDER_CALL_1_DATE 	,	[3] PROVIDER_CALL_2_DATE 	,	[4] PROVIDER_CALL_3_DATE 	,	[5] PROVIDER_CALL_4_DATE 	,	[6] PROVIDER_CALL_5_DATE 	,	SQ.MX_SD FROM (	 	SELECT NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 		,NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE 		,PROVIDER_NPI 		,PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME 		,PROVIDER_LAST_NAME,	MARKET 		,CALLLIST_CD 		,PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER 		,PROVIDER_CALL_DATE 		,HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST 		,TOTAL_CALLS_MADE 		,CALL_SEQ 	FROM @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS  	WHERE SCRUB_FLG=\'Y\' 	AND TOTAL_CALLS_MADE = 0 		AND CASE  		WHEN SCRUB_FLG=\'N\'  THEN 0  		ELSE 1  	END	<=5 	)A PIVOT( MAX(PROVIDER_CALL_DATE)  FOR CALL_SEQ IN ([2], [3], [4], [5], [6]) 		) AS DT  INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT NY_PA_STAGING_PyID, MAX(PROVIDER_CALL_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY NY_PA_STAGING_PyID)  AS MX_SD FROM @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS ) SQ 	ON DT.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID = SQ.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID  	 DECLARE @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS_RESULT TABLE (	NY_PA_STAGING_PyID VARCHAR(20), 												PROVIDER_CALL_1_RESULT VARCHAR(200), 												PROVIDER_CALL_2_RESULT VARCHAR(200), 												PROVIDER_CALL_3_RESULT VARCHAR(200), 												PROVIDER_CALL_4_RESULT VARCHAR(200), 												PROVIDER_CALL_5_RESULT VARCHAR(200), 												SCRUB_RESULT VARCHAR(200))   Insert into @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS_RESULT SELECT DISTINCT 	RES.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,	 	[1] PROVIDER_CALL_1_RESULT, 	[2] PROVIDER_CALL_2_RESULT, 	[3] PROVIDER_CALL_3_RESULT, 	[4] PROVIDER_CALL_4_RESULT, 	[5] PROVIDER_CALL_5_RESULT 	,SR.PROVIDER_CALL_RESULT FROM (	 	SELECT  		PROVIDER_CALL_RESULT 		,NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 												,CALL_SEQ  							FROM @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS  	WHERE SCRUB_FLG=\'N\' 		AND CASE  			WHEN SCRUB_FLG=\'Y\' THEN 0  			ELSE 1  		END<=5 )A PIVOT( MAX(PROVIDER_CALL_RESULT)  FOR CALL_SEQ IN ([1], [2], [3], [4],[5]) ) AS RES  LEFT JOIN @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS SR 	ON RES.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID = SR.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 	AND SR.SCRUB_FLG = \'Y\' WHERE SR.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID IS NOT NULL AND SR.PROVIDER_CALL_RESULT IS NOT NULL  UNION  SELECT DISTINCT 	RES.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,	 	[2] PROVIDER_CALL_1_RESULT, 	[3] PROVIDER_CALL_2_RESULT, 	[4] PROVIDER_CALL_3_RESULT, 	[5] PROVIDER_CALL_4_RESULT, 	[6] PROVIDER_CALL_5_RESULT 	,SR.PROVIDER_CALL_RESULT FROM (	 	SELECT  		PROVIDER_CALL_RESULT 		,NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 		,CALL_SEQ 	FROM @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS  	WHERE SCRUB_FLG=\'Y\' 	AND TOTAL_CALLS_MADE = 0 		AND CASE  			WHEN SCRUB_FLG=\'N\' THEN 0  			ELSE 1  		END<=5 )A PIVOT( MAX(PROVIDER_CALL_RESULT)  FOR CALL_SEQ IN ([2], [3], [4], [5], [6]) ) AS RES  LEFT JOIN @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS SR 	ON RES.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID = SR.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 	AND SR.SCRUB_FLG = \'Y\' WHERE SR.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID IS NOT NULL AND SR.PROVIDER_CALL_RESULT IS NOT NULL    SELECT 	 D.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 	,D.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE 	,D.PROVIDER_NPI 	,D.PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME 	,D.PROVIDER_LAST_NAME 	,D.MARKET 	,D.CALLLIST_CD 	,D.PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER 		,D.TOTAL_CALLS_MADE 	,D.PROVIDER_CALL_1_DATE 	,D.PROVIDER_CALL_2_DATE 	,D.PROVIDER_CALL_3_DATE 	,D.PROVIDER_CALL_4_DATE 	,D.PROVIDER_CALL_5_DATE 	,D.SCRUB_DATE  		,REPLACE(R.PROVIDER_CALL_1_RESULT,\'Inactivates members after x attempts\',\'Deactivates record after x attempts\') AS PROVIDER_CALL_1_RESULT 	,REPLACE(R.PROVIDER_CALL_2_RESULT,\'Inactivates members after x attempts\',\'Deactivates record after x attempts\') AS PROVIDER_CALL_2_RESULT 	,REPLACE(R.PROVIDER_CALL_3_RESULT,\'Inactivates members after x attempts\',\'Deactivates record after x attempts\') AS PROVIDER_CALL_3_RESULT 	,REPLACE(R.PROVIDER_CALL_4_RESULT,\'Inactivates members after x attempts\',\'Deactivates record after x attempts\') AS PROVIDER_CALL_4_RESULT 	,REPLACE(R.PROVIDER_CALL_5_RESULT,\'Inactivates members after x attempts\',\'Deactivates record after x attempts\') AS PROVIDER_CALL_5_RESULT 	,REPLACE(R.SCRUB_RESULT,\'Inactivates members after x attempts\',\'Deactivates record after x attempts\') AS SCRUB_RESULT FROM @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS_RESULT R  FULL OUTER JOIN  @SCRUB_PROVIDER_NY_CALLS_DATE D  	ON R.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID= D.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource split($TextFilesExportInd == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(ExportTextFile,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME} = toString(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME),
		{Copy of PROVIDER_LAST_NAME} = toString(PROVIDER_LAST_NAME),
		{Copy of SCRUB_DATE} = SCRUB_DATE,
		{Copy of CALLLIST_CD} = toString(CALLLIST_CD),
		{Copy of PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER} = PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER,
		{Copy of NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE} = NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE,
		{Copy of PROVIDER_CALL_3_DATE} = PROVIDER_CALL_3_DATE,
		{Copy of PROVIDER_CALL_5_DATE} = PROVIDER_CALL_5_DATE,
		{Copy of PROVIDER_CALL_4_DATE} = PROVIDER_CALL_4_DATE,
		{Copy of PROVIDER_CALL_5_RESULT} = toString(PROVIDER_CALL_5_RESULT),
		{Copy of MARKET} = toString(MARKET),
		{Copy of PROVIDER_CALL_2_RESULT} = toString(PROVIDER_CALL_2_RESULT),
		{Copy of TOTAL_CALLS_MADE} = TOTAL_CALLS_MADE,
		{Copy of PROVIDER_CALL_1_DATE} = PROVIDER_CALL_1_DATE,
		{Copy of NY_PA_STAGING_PyID} = toString(NY_PA_STAGING_PyID),
		{Copy of PROVIDER_NPI} = toString(PROVIDER_NPI),
		{Copy of PROVIDER_CALL_2_DATE} = PROVIDER_CALL_2_DATE,
		{Copy of PROVIDER_CALL_4_RESULT} = toString(PROVIDER_CALL_4_RESULT),
		{Copy of PROVIDER_CALL_1_RESULT} = toString(PROVIDER_CALL_1_RESULT),
		{Copy of SCRUB_RESULT} = toString(SCRUB_RESULT),
		{Copy of PROVIDER_CALL_3_RESULT} = toString(PROVIDER_CALL_3_RESULT)) ~> DataConversion
ConditionalSplit@ExportTextFile sink(input(
		PROVIDER_CALL_2_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		PROVIDER_CALL_2_RESULT as string,
		MARKET as string,
		PROVIDER_CALL_1_RESULT as string,
		PROVIDER_CALL_5_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PROVIDER_LAST_NAME as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_PyID as string,
		PROVIDER_CALL_3_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PROVIDER_CALL_1_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PROVIDER_CALL_4_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PROVIDER_CALL_5_RESULT as string,
		PROVIDER_CALL_4_RESULT as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PROVIDER_CALL_3_RESULT as string,
		SCRUB_RESULT as string,
		TOTAL_CALLS_MADE as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PROVIDER_CALL_2_DATE,
		PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME,
		PROVIDER_CALL_2_RESULT,
		MARKET,
		PROVIDER_CALL_1_RESULT,
		PROVIDER_CALL_5_DATE,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE,
		PROVIDER_LAST_NAME,
		NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,
		PROVIDER_CALL_3_DATE,
		CALLLIST_CD,
		PROVIDER_NPI,
		PROVIDER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER,
		PROVIDER_CALL_1_DATE,
		PROVIDER_CALL_4_DATE,
		PROVIDER_CALL_5_RESULT,
		PROVIDER_CALL_4_RESULT,
		SCRUB_DATE,
		PROVIDER_CALL_3_RESULT,
		SCRUB_RESULT,
		TOTAL_CALLS_MADE)) ~> FlatFileDestination
